ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels with approximately 15-20% high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels concentrated on the distal lateral margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two distinct, high-contrast light-colored patches located at the distal tips; the left patch is larger and contains internal dark linear streaks; the right patch is narrower and concentrated at the upper edge; the central 70% of the surface is uniform low-intensity black with fine white speckling.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression with a calculated vertex angle of approximately 45 degrees; notch depth is roughly 15% of the total vertical height of the fluke lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the outer third of the trailing edges; several distinct jagged peaks are visible on the far right lateral edge; the inner third toward the notch is relatively smooth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a convex curve from the lateral tips toward the central notch; the right lobe shows a slightly more pronounced curvature than the left.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive distribution of small, circular high-contrast white pixel clusters (pitting) across the black ventral surface, particularly dense in the lower-left and lower-right quadrants.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent vertical high-contrast linear mark on the left lobe near the peduncle; several fine, unaligned horizontal and diagonal scratches visible on the mid-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Minor edge erosion and fraying at the extreme lateral tips; no major traumatic amputations or large-scale lesions are detected.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct circular high-contrast pixel formation is visible at the central base of the fluke where it joins the peduncle.
